data.name: Whispers in the fog
data.detailed_description:
The road disappears into the fog, but something out there already knows you are here.

Whispers in the Fog is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, environmental storytelling, and uncovering a deeply personal mystery.

You awaken alone on a remote, rain-soaked road with no memory of who you are or how you arrived. With only a flashlight to guide you, you follow the road into a forgotten place swallowed by fog, where abandoned buildings stand untouched and distant sounds suggest you may not be alone.

Explore deserted roads, decaying houses, abandoned structures, cemeteries, tunnels, and forgotten corners of a town that seems frozen in time. Search interiors, discover hidden paths, unlock sealed areas, and uncover notes, photographs, personal belongings, and other fragments left behind.

Piece by piece, these discoveries begin to reveal what happened here — and why the place feels strangely familiar.

But the deeper you explore, the harder it becomes to separate memory from reality.

Some whispers guide you.

Others deceive you.

Explore the surroundings and uncover the truth

Every location holds another piece of the mystery. Search abandoned buildings, hidden paths, forgotten rooms, and places consumed by fog as you uncover clues about what happened here — and why you may be connected to it.

The deeper you go, the more familiar everything begins to feel.

And some truths were never meant to be remembered.

Gameplay

Exploration, investigation, and environmental storytelling are at the heart of Whispers in the Fog. Equipped with a flashlight and a worn backpack, you search abandoned locations for clues, useful items, keys, and objects needed to solve environmental puzzles and open new paths.

Every location tells part of the story through its surroundings. Search rooms, inspect forgotten belongings, discover hidden entrances, and piece together events from the traces left behind.

Remote roads, abandoned houses, forgotten structures, cemeteries, tunnels, and other decaying locations form a connected journey where progression comes from observation, exploration, and uncovering what happened before you arrived.

Atmosphere and Lighting

Dynamic weather, volumetric fog, and cinematic lighting shape the world of Whispers in the Fog. Rain sweeps across empty roads, distant lights disappear into the mist, and shadows shift through abandoned places and overgrown paths.

The fog is not just a visual element — it is a presence.

From the moment you awaken, the world feels alive with quiet dread. Visibility is limited, light is often scarce, and distant shapes blur the line between what is real and what your mind wants you to believe.

Sometimes the fog reveals the way forward.

Sometimes it hides what should never be found.

Features

Atmospheric First-Person Horror
Experience the world entirely in first person, where fog, darkness, oppressive weather, and environmental detail create a constant sense of isolation and unease.

Environmental Puzzle Solving
Search your surroundings for clues, keys, symbols, documents, and objects that help solve environmental puzzles, unlock sealed areas, and reveal new paths forward.

Psychological Sound Design
3D spatial audio and unsettling ambient soundscapes blur the line between reality and imagination. Distant footsteps, unexplained sounds, and whispers may guide you… or mislead you.

Cinematic Lighting and Fog
Powered by Unreal Engine 5, dynamic lighting, volumetric fog, and changing weather transform each location and reinforce the atmosphere of uncertainty and dread.

Fragmented Narrative
Discover scattered memories, notes, photographs, personal belongings, and forgotten artifacts that gradually reveal the truth behind your identity and your connection to this place.

Exploration and Discovery
Follow remote roads, investigate abandoned houses, explore forgotten structures, cemeteries, tunnels, and hidden paths — each revealing another fragment of the story.

Minimal UI, Maximum Immersion
A physical backpack and journal system allow you to manage important items, clues, and discoveries while keeping the interface unobtrusive and the focus on the world around you.

Subtle Horror, Lasting Impact
Horror is built through anticipation, uncertainty, and psychological tension rather than constant jump scares. Sometimes the most disturbing thing is what you think you saw in the distance.

Restrained Encounters
You are not always alone.

Strange entities and shadowy figures may emerge from the fog, but confrontation is not the focus of the experience. When danger becomes unavoidable, the tools you discover can help you survive.

  • Use your flashlight to illuminate the darkness and interact with certain supernatural threats.

  • Find improvised weapons for moments when confrontation cannot be avoided.

  • Limited firearms may offer protection in desperate situations.

Combat is intentionally tense and restrained. Some threats can be confronted, while others are better avoided.

Survival depends as much on observation and awareness as it does on the courage to keep moving deeper into the fog.

data.short_description: Whispers in the Fog is a first-person psychological horror game where exploration and atmosphere drive the experience. Search abandoned locations, uncover unsettling clues, solve environmental puzzles, and discover what happened to a world slowly disappearing into the fog.
